query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total!: i64",
               COALESCE(SUM(t.unread_count > 0), 0) AS "unread!: i64"
        FROM threads t
        WHERE t.account_id = ?
          AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM thread_labels e
                WHERE e.account_id = t.account_id AND e.thread_id = t.id
                  AND e.label_id IN ('SPAM', 'TRASH'))
